due_when.clears_when: scripts/backtest_ict_scalp.py::_build_htf_series/merge_asof no longer hands an HTF bar's future close to earlier base bars (causal alignment, with a test), and the ict_scalp evidence records are rebuilt on the causal harness

origin.rerun: In scripts/backtest_ict_scalp.py, _build_htf_series resamples with default label=left/closed=left and takes close=last, then run_backtest merge_asof(direction=backward) onto base timestamps: the 10:00 HTF row (close of 10:55) is given to the 10:05 base bar. Re-measure: run the harness with default HTF vs a causal HTF (latest base close vs EMA seeded from completed HTF bars) on the same 365d feed; on 6 ict_scalp legs 2026-10-01 pooled net R was -37.9 (harness) vs -140.7 (causal), 1177 vs 1217 trades.

what: ict_scalp backtest harness HTF bias filter has LOOKAHEAD: the HTF close used to gate a 5m/15m entry can be up to 55 min in the future. MEASURED 2026-10-01 (365d Binance spot, 6 crypto ict_scalp legs, config-exact p0-style run, --sim-breakeven): harness-HTF win rate 51-56% vs causal 44-50%; pooled net R -37.9 vs -140.7 (n 1177 vs 1217). Every committed ict_scalp strategy-evidence record built with default HTF therefore overstates the filter's contribution. Not fixed here (harness change alters evidence records; needs a rebuild). Also unreconciled: my full-window harness runs are strongly negative (OFF pooled -377R) while committed OOS evidence records are slightly positive (e.g. xrp_15m +4.08R OOS) - setting differences (folds, cost stack, feed) not isolated.
